title: EP01 — 첫 타설 / 3분의 판단
intent: Make the first episode play like a field drama and strategy scene, not a safety quiz.
dramatic_question: When schedule, incomplete information and people all compete for attention, what do you choose to see first—and what does that choice make you miss?
design_rules: No choice label may read as obviously safe/correct versus reckless/wrong.
Each primary option must solve one real problem while spending attention, time, authority or trust somewhere else.
Immediate feedback shows the local effect; later events reveal delayed social/operational consequences.
The player is not rewarded for stopping everything by default; precise coordination can be safer and faster than indiscriminate delay.
Near miss is a consequence branch, not a punishment animation or game-over.
Dialogue should contain field pressure, interruptions, incomplete observations and role-specific priorities.
Scene rhythm alternates: wide situation → close dialogue → choice → visible field consequence → later return.

live_beats.transition: each choice gets an immediate trade-off result
signal becomes more or less actionable
first choice changes what is known; second changes how people move

live_beats.choice_shape: system routes to the earned result

live_beats.transition: engine/noise/hose/movement montage closes the operational arc
